links.upstream.ts is the original app/engine/links.ts.
links-3d.js adapts its counting-sort spatial grid, nearest-neighbour insertion
and undirected-pair deduplication to three dimensions (27 adjacent cells).
Prisma changes: JavaScript port, third coordinate, grid axis cap 64, finite input
validation. This is not the author's unidentified two-million-particle demo.

Prisma builds the graph in the nucleus's rest configuration, then moves its
endpoints with existing particle trajectories. It is a persistent visual graph,
not a cloth simulation or a dynamic all-particle neighbour solver.
